item.title: DOH pushes vape ban as PH falls behind region in campaign against e-cigarettes
item.description: MANILA, Philippines — Health Secretary Ted Herbosa sought to ban vape products, saying the Philippines is falling behind other Southeast Asian countries in the prohibition of e-cigarettes.In a radio interview on Saturday, Herbosa said banning vape products would help prevent their harmful effects, particularly among the youth.He said that in other Southeast Asian countries, like Singapore, vaping has been banned to develop the first smoke-free generation.“Singapore overtook us.
